text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-INC-78123 fired: auth-service high 401 error rate (>30% requests). Paging on-call.

Samir Patel: acked PD-INC-78123 (Samir Patel) :raised_hand:

Samir Patel: seeing sudden 401s for multiple endpoints. validator logs show `KID not found` and `signature verification failed` spikes. First saw errors at ~1834567800 UTC.

Deepa Rao: checking JWKS and caches. Any recent rotations or manual key ops in last 30m?

Jules Chen: performed a scheduled rotation ~22m ago. KMS rotation completed and key-manager reports new signing key active. I expected CI job to push jwks to edge caches, but not yet sure it completed.

Marta Lopez: redis cluster reports several eviction events in the jwks prefix; node hot-restart happened about the same time. re-populating jwks cache from key-manager now.

Samir Patel: mitigation idea: enable a short-lived permissive mode to accept tokens signed by the previous key. Can we do that quickly via feature flag?

Jules Chen: creating flag `AUTH_JWKS_PERMISSIVE_MODE=true` and will roll a tiny canary (5%) first.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for auth-service@r2.1 -> 5% of instances

Ryan Kim: canary metrics: auth-401-rate on canary nodes down from 38% -> 6% within 60s. good sign.

Deepa Rao: CDN logs show edge POPs still serving old jwks for some regions. issuing CDN purge for /.well-known/jwks.json to speed propagation.

Marta Lopez: jwks cache rehydrate in redis completed. comparing hashes: before: deadbeef, after: cafebabe. some gateways still reading stale CDN caches; propagation ~1-4m.

Samir Patel: roll permissive mode to 100%? We should reduce customer impact quickly. Also notify support to surface potentially impacted customers.

Jules Chen: rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: rollout completed for auth-service@r2.1 -> 100% instances

Samir Patel: post-rollout auth-401-rate dropped to ~1.5% cluster-wide. remaining failures appear to be clients presenting tokens signed with a future KID (maybe misaligned clocks or test keys).

Deepa Rao: initial impact estimate: about 8-14% of requests in the window returned 401s, peak lasted ~10 minutes. Most affected: hosted API gateway traffic and some regional POPs with stale jwks.

Marta Lopez: root cause preliminary: rotation sequence completed at KMS and key-manager, but cache propagation was interrupted by redis evictions and CDN edge staleness, causing some validators to lack the new public key and throw KID mismatch.

Jules Chen: mitigation actions executed:
- enabled `AUTH_JWKS_PERMISSIVE_MODE` to accept previous KID
- forced redis jwks rehydrate across cluster
- purged CDN edges for jwks endpoint
- canary -> full rollout of permissive flag

Ryan Kim: customer comms: drafting short notice. proposed: "We rotated signing keys; during propagation a subset of edge validators returned authentication errors (401). We deployed a safe fallback and restored service. No token disclosure detected." Will attach impacted org list.

Samir Patel: handoff notes for the next on-call (in ~1h):
- leave `AUTH_JWKS_PERMISSIVE_MODE=true` for 45m, then remove if metrics stable
- monitor auth-401-rate, jwks_cache_hit_ratio, cdn_jwks_age
- escalate if 401>5% for >5m
- follow-ups: atomic key-roll runbook, add redis eviction alerts for jwks keys, add CDN purge as step in key rotation CI

Deepa Rao: create follow-ups: Jules -> implement atomic jwks rollout (JIRA RED-1210), Marta -> redis eviction alert tuned for jwks namespace (RED-1211), Ryan -> finalize customer notice and affected org list (RED-1212).

Marta Lopez: adding temporary alert: trigger if jwks_hash changes and jwks_cache_hit_ratio drops >20% within 3m.

Jules Chen: starting postmortem doc; initial timeline and remediation plan will be posted by EOD.

Samir Patel: final update: system stabilized, auth 401 back to baseline ~0.25%. keeping permissive mode enabled for 40m before scheduled removal.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-INC-78123 marked RESOLVED by Samir Patel

Samir Patel: closing thread. Please add any notes to the postmortem and link JIRA tickets. :white_check_mark:

Deepa Rao: thanks everyone for quick triage and clear handoffs. good job.
